errors.says: A fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators of the factorization suffices for (H,D)->(H+AD,D) with a interchanges.
errors.paper: q must avoid every denominator in the table of factors and inverses and also every numerator of a diagonal entry of an invertible factor, so the triangular factors stay invertible mod q (1415-1423).

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. It builds the scalar exchange, frames and nested labels, giving the budget Wm-2N+2L with L<N/2. It then gives the bit and phase interfaces with s<Wm, the explicit tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, matrix shears as recursive interchanges with F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and the layer recurrence. Every reduction (synthetic transforms, signed packing, resampling, chirp, CRT, twist, exact recovery and the cost table) follows the paper with correctly cited lines. The only thin spots are the guard-width (arithmetic-depth) bound for the layer and the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument, which are asserted rather than derived.

steps.note: Gives the fixed linear network on triples of [100] (v=C(100,3), N=v^3), correct for arbitrary scratch, with three stages sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every auxiliary wire. m=h^3 is not written out; the plan only says 'an m-dimensional bilinear space'.
Has a common frame per gate that commutes with the pointwise gate by linearity, implementing D_out S D_in^{-1}, so edges pay only for frame changes.
Nondegenerate tensor labels; every edge joins nested labels; the only decreasing edges are the central wires 3->4, each losing P⊗F of dimension h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels; the N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
Gives the telescoping to Wm-2N, plus 2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) gives s<Wm.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m and identity elsewhere, so Phi frames give H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular parts O(V), one interchange per one of Pi, so the edge ranks total s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain in order: the fixed bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with the only loss on central 3->4 edges, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, shears as exactly s recursive interchanges, and the recurrence giving e^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only small gap is that m=h^3 is never written out explicitly.
